results.title: PM Modi, visiting Canadian Foreign Minister hold ‘productive discussion’ on further strengthening bilateral ties
results.description: New Delhi, Oct 14: Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand called on Prime Minister Narendra Modi in New Delhi on Wednesday, discussing further strengthening of bilateral ties in trade, technology, security, energy, education and people-to-people exchanges.
